title: ID0431887-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/T1 170004362] SECC- KF12 Faulty
description:
Reported issue:
With L3 support we performed a troubleshooting analysis related to
the ticket ID0425356. By performing an update of the ECOG 1.4.11
KF12, the controller didn't ping anymore. Together with Fosco
Servidei we tried to recover the status of the decive, but it has
been declared that it's faulted and must be replaced.
Solution:  Replacement of the eCoG -KF12
yyyy-mm-dd: 10/07/2025
